  "w01": "At dawn, the lighthouse keeper found a green bottle wedged between the harbor steps. Inside lay a scrap of paper, dry as autumn grass. Leave the light burning tomorrow, it said. My father is coming home. There was no signature, only a date forty years old. Elias carried it upstairs and set it beside the lamp. That evening, the electricity failed across the island. He fetched the old oil burner, polished its glass, and climbed until his knees trembled. Beyond the windows, darkness folded over the sea. Near midnight, a fishing boat appeared, towing another vessel through the reef. On its deck stood a gray-haired woman, looking up at the tower with both hands pressed against her heart.",
  "w02": "凌晨四点，城市像一封尚未拆开的信。路灯把微黄的光铺在湿漉漉的街面上，清洁工推着车缓缓经过。早餐铺亮起第一盏灯，蒸汽贴着玻璃升起。远处一辆货车驶过桥梁，声音很快被夜色收走。有人刚刚下班，有人已经出门，更多的人仍在梦里。天边透出浅灰，整座城市轻轻翻了个身。",
  "w03": "- Recursion means solving a problem by using the same steps on a smaller version of it.\n- Imagine opening a box, finding a smaller box inside, and opening that one the same way.\n- You need a stopping rule, like stopping when you finally find a box with no smaller box inside."
